episodes.instruction: Position the rounded base blue cup squarely on top of the coaster made of smooth wood.
Move the smooth blue cup for liquids to the flat surface gray wooden coaster
Use the arm to position the smooth blue cup for liquids on the round coaster with light streaks.
Use the arm to put the cup with light blue color onto the light gray round grainy coaster.
Use the arm to put the medium blue cylindrical cup onto the coaster made of smooth wood.
Stick the cup for holding liquids onto the grainy texture coaster carefully.
Position the smooth blue cup for liquids squarely on top of the small coaster with grain texture.
Use the arm to set the medium-sized plastic blue cup on the flat surface gray wooden coaster
Direct the cup with light blue color to the light gray streaked wooden coaster and let it rest.
Lift the cup for holding liquids and stick it onto the smooth round palm-sized coaster.
Align the plastic cup for drinks and set it down on the small coaster with grain texture
Drop the smooth blue cup for liquids on top of the small coaster with grain texture.
Grab the smooth blue drinking cup, then place it onto the flat surface gray wooden coaster.
Using the arm, slide the light blue plastic cup onto the round coaster.
Lift the plastic cup for drinks up and drop it on the flat round wooden coaster.
Place the light blue plastic cup on top of the light gray round grainy coaster
Use an arm to place the cup with smooth plastic surface on the round coaster with light streaks
Drop the rounded base blue cup firmly on the round coaster using arm
Position the cup with smooth plastic surface above and drop it on the round coaster
Use the arm to set the smooth blue drinking cup on the coaster made of smooth wood
